checks.topic: Single-call ownership, cancellation and source identity
observations: ReadbackMembers is created only by the new private readonly Host call. It owns pins cloned from each actual member Trainer Arc and Qualification config; no endpoint, source owner, signer or journal is reopened.
Every invocation receives a new Arc<()> call identity and a new member-vector allocation. The proof borrows that invocation, is not Clone/serde, and is not stored on Host or returned as evidence.

begin consumes admission by CAS; read replaces the cursor with Refused before validation or await. A rejected or cancelled slot cannot be retried through the same proof. finish consumes the proof and requires Complete plus exact call-identity Arc and source-allocation Arc.
The new readback_call rejects an already composed ReadbackMembers source; the existing call method also rejects that variant. There is no nested or cross-request proof creation path.
The actual Host retains its existing owner mutex, complete-response fence and original retained-receipt equality checks. The candidate adds no guard across await and no reentrant owner callback.
